label: STRESS · new evidence
text: The supplier confirms that Option A cannot export the rules for repeating bookings or the record of past approvals. Option B could be extended, but its owner still has no measurements for the busiest usage times. The person responsible for the trial says that waiting until every unknown is answered would miss next term's start. A limited evaluation of one option is possible. Compare the effect of waiting with the unresolved risks of using, supporting and later leaving each option. Do not invent a money value for the delay.
